QUOTE: Which files then produce rows depends on each harvester's extension list. Files in scope that no harvester claims are reported as "not indexed," not dropped silently.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that extension tables decide which in-scope files get rows. It never names either filter the item requires: the parse-built front end claiming file types doxygen can't read, or binary classification dropping files with misleading extensions.
